title: Cafe Rise 149 | Clever Exchange | Infinity Rising
description:
In this episode, Rob and Josh are joined by Patrick of Anvil discussing their new partnership and how their latest developments will be shaping Infinity Rising.

We kick things off with a look at the Apartment Builder status, breaking down how player housing is evolving and what it unlocks for progression, creativity, and social play. From there, we cover RISE rewards, including what’s live now and what players should be paying attention to next.

The conversation moves into a marketing update, outlining current initiatives and what’s coming in the near term, followed by discussion around Node Summit and why it matters for the broader ecosystem.

We then jump in-game to talk marketplace development, new systems coming online, and how content is continuing to expand. After covering the latest game content, we open things up with community questions, addressing feedback and curiosities directly from players.

And finally… a swift leak 👀 — a moment you won’t want to miss.

🔔 Don’t miss out, like, subscribe, and hit the bell to stay ahead of every drop.


00:00 Beverage Choices
01:50 Apartment Builder
06:53 RISE Rewards
12:23 Marketing Update
17:54 Node Summit
21:59 Game Content
28:10 Special Guest
48:47 Community Questions
52:34 Leak!

Linktree: https://linktr.ee/infinityrisinggame

Infinity Rising is an open-world sandbox MMO and multiverse simulator set between Cornucopias, the nation in the sky, the fractured Earth below, and the unknown worlds beyond. Born from the aftermath of the Calamity—a quantum storm that shattered reality—players rebuild civilization under vast domes powered by advanced quantum tech. 

Guided by “The Messenger,” you’ll explore, gather, craft, trade, and defend in a player-driven economy across land, sky, and beyond. Quantum Rifts, mysterious anomalies tied to The Prophet and The Terra, challenge survival and progress as players rise into infinite possibilities. Whether you craft, farm, fight, or build empires, every choice shapes the future of the Cornucopias Republic—humanity’s last beacon of hope. 

Infinity Rising is a call to ascend without end—world, player, and technology together.
